caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a traditional cradleboard or papoose, constructed with two visible wooden hoops at each end providing structure. The central body of the cradleboard is covered in a light grayish-green material. On this covering, there is a prominent embroidered decorative pattern in red, orange, and yellow, with symmetrical geometric shapes and a cross-like motif in the center area. At the top section, partially covered by an arched hood, there is a small figure of a baby, wrapped securely, with a visible face colored in beige tones and a blue accent running vertically on the head covering. The hood itself has additional detailing, including a floral-like orange and green design, and red lines on the sides. The overall background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or decorations present in the drawing.
title: Cree Papoose Doll
